column1: # The prototype's demo tree (seedFs) on the two sandbox volumes (ADR 0019).
# Columns, tab-separated: path (HD/ or T7/ first), kind (folder, hidden folder,
# app package, file, image, clips), modified (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), and for a
# file optionally its size in MiB, or in KiB with a k (48k); other files hold
# one line of text. An image is a picture made by tools/sandbox/make_image.py,
# so the icon view and the details pane show a thumbnail. A clips row is
# a folder of equal clips, with the size of each in MiB and their count: copying
# it to the other volume takes long enough to see progress and to cancel.
